claims.statement: DecisionTraceBuilder accepts only model-turn events; record_decision and record_tool_selection exist as compatibility sinks that are explicitly excluded from v2 traces, so prompts, candidate answers, tool payloads/results, evidence, and exception contents are never recorded.

The trace is bounded by MAX_DECISION_TRACE_EVENTS=64, MAX_DECISION_TRACE_BYTES=128KiB serialized JSON, and MAX_MODEL_REASONING_CHARS=16KiB per event; an oversize trace logs a warning and returns None rather than failing the turn.

Tool names recorded into the trace are filtered against the closed allowlist _ALLOWED_MODEL_TOOL_NAMES and capped at 8 per event; oversized reasoning is truncated and tagged reasoning_status="truncated".

The retention tick clears decision_trace to NULL (never deletes the row) on Settings.decision_trace_retention_interval_seconds (default 86400 s = daily), bounded by Settings.decision_trace_retention_batch_size (default 200) per tick and Settings.decision_trace_retention_days (default 30); the tick is registered via register_unique_tick in main.py lifespan.

BotRun persists conversation_id, started_at, ended_at, version_at_start, proposed_reply, outcome, stage_timings JSONB, trace_id (indexed, propagated from webhook through RQ → BotRunState → graph), runtime_revision_id FK (RESTRICT), authority_generation, runtime_fingerprint, outcome_metadata, and optional decision_trace JSONB.

Stage timings carry per-stage milliseconds (webhook_to_pickup_ms, preamble_ms, lane, lead_ms, llm_queue_ms, llm_model_ms, safety_ms, send_ms, total_ms), queue_depth, intent, llm_calls, llm_call_ms array, prompt/completion/cached_tokens, tool_breakdown, retried_429, and degraded; aggregated via percentile_cont over (stage_timings->>'<key>')::int.

GET /api/v1/bot_runs is visible to any authenticated user (admin + recruiter); GET /api/v1/bot_runs/{run_id} is require_admin and 404s on missing; both filter by conversation_id and outcome, ordered started_at DESC, id DESC, paginated (max 200 per page).

record_audit inserts an AuditEvent (app/models/audit.py) and flushes without committing, so callers can compose audit rows with other writes; privileged actions (integration secret rotations, OA token refresh) write through this helper, and payload stores changed keys only — never secret values.
